_comment: Every planned tool, in display order. Home, hubs and search read this list; a card links only once its page is published. {gstRate} is replaced from data/nz/gst.json.

tools.name: Take-home pay calculator
tools.blurb: Gross to net for any pay period: PAYE, ACC, student loan and KiwiSaver, using official rates.
tools.kw: paye tax salary wage net income acc student loan take home pay

tools.name: KiwiSaver calculator
tools.blurb: Your contributions, your employer's and the government's, plus an illustrative projection.
tools.kw: kiwisaver retirement savings employer contribution government

tools.name: GST calculator
tools.blurb: Add or remove {gstRate} GST, with line items and exact cents.
tools.kw: gst tax invoice add remove percent goods services

tools.name: Flatmate rent and bills splitter
tools.blurb: Split rent and shared bills by room, income or days present, to the cent.
tools.kw: flatmate rent bills split share house power internet

tools.name: Unit converter
tools.blurb: Length, area, mass, volume, temperature, speed and fuel economy.
tools.kw: convert units metric imperial acres stone mpg inches feet

tools.name: Days between dates
tools.blurb: Count days, weeks and months between two dates, with or without the end date.
tools.kw: days between dates count difference weeks

tools.name: Age calculator
tools.blurb: Exact age in years, months and days, plus the next birthday.
tools.kw: age birthday years old

tools.name: Add or subtract days
tools.blurb: Find the date any number of days, weeks, months or years away.
tools.kw: add subtract days weeks months deadline date

tools.name: Working days calculator
tools.blurb: Business days between dates, with NZ public holidays and anniversary days.
tools.kw: working days business holidays public matariki anniversary

tools.name: Time zone converter
tools.blurb: Compare New Zealand time with anywhere, daylight saving included.
tools.kw: time zone converter nzdt nzst utc australia uk us

tools.name: Countdown timer
tools.blurb: Count down to a date and time in any zone.
tools.kw: countdown timer event days until

tools.name: Printable calendar
tools.blurb: Any month or year, week starting Monday or Sunday, NZ holidays marked.
tools.kw: printable calendar month year print holidays

tools.name: Weekly planner and timetable
tools.blurb: Weekly planners and hourly timetables, blank or labelled.
tools.kw: weekly planner timetable schedule print

tools.name: Printable checklist
tools.blurb: Turn a list into a neat checklist with tick boxes.
tools.kw: checklist to do list print tick boxes

tools.name: Text cleaner
tools.blurb: Trim, dedupe, sort and reshape lines of text in one pass.
tools.kw: text cleaner clean lines trim sort duplicates whitespace

tools.name: Word and character counter
tools.blurb: Words, characters, sentences and reading time as you type.
tools.kw: word counter character count reading time sentences

tools.name: Remove duplicate lines
tools.blurb: Keep the first or last copy of each line, in the original order.
tools.kw: remove duplicate lines unique dedupe list

tools.name: Remove blank lines
tools.blurb: Strip empty and whitespace-only lines from pasted text.
tools.kw: remove blank empty lines whitespace

tools.name: Sort lines alphabetically
tools.blurb: A to Z, Z to A, numeric or by length, with proper accent handling.
tools.kw: sort lines alphabetical order a-z

tools.name: Add text to start and end of lines
tools.blurb: Wrap each line in quotes, commas, bullets or any prefix and suffix.
tools.kw: add prefix suffix quotes commas lines wrap
